toa-adventure-tracker.app.title: Wilderness Travel
toa-adventure-tracker.app.clearRollsHint: Clears every roll made today without touching the day counter.
toa-adventure-tracker.app.noParty: No travellers found. Check the "Traveller source" world option.
toa-adventure-tracker.app.quietDay: A quiet day. Nothing worth reporting.
toa-adventure-tracker.app.notApplied: Consequences are NOT written to the character sheets automatically (world option).
toa-adventure-tracker.moon.tooltip: Day {day} of {length} in the lunar cycle — {percent}% illuminated
toa-adventure-tracker.role.navigator.hin: Keeps the party on course. On a failure the party gets lost and covers no ground at all.
toa-adventure-tracker.role.vanguard.hint: Watches the front. Fail here and you walk into the ambush instead of seeing it.
toa-adventure-tracker.role.rearguard.hin: Covers the tracks. On a failure something picks up your trail.
toa-adventure-tracker.role.waterbearer.h: Finds water — drinkable water. On a success, 1d6 + WIS gallons.
toa-adventure-tracker.role.forager.label: Forager
toa-adventure-tracker.role.forager.hint: Finds food. On a success, 1d6 + WIS pounds.
toa-adventure-tracker.role.quartermaster: Makes camp. A bad camp is a night that does not count as a rest.
toa-adventure-tracker.role.medic.label: Medic
toa-adventure-tracker.role.medic.hint: Treats what the jungle did. The only role that takes exhaustion back off.
Keeps the map. Cannot find the way, but can find the way back to it — a wasted day instead of a lost one.
toa-adventure-tracker.reason.lost: Lost — the day disappears into the undergrowth.
toa-adventure-tracker.reason.rescued: Lost, but the cartographer finds the way back onto the map. A wasted day instead of a lost one.
toa-adventure-tracker.reason.fastPace: Fast pace, and a navigator who did more than scrape by.
toa-adventure-tracker.reason.fastNoMargi: Fast pace, but the navigation was not clear enough for a second march.
toa-adventure-tracker.reason.blocked: {event} costs the rest of the day.
toa-adventure-tracker.reason.exhausted: Exhaustion (level {level}) — nobody is carrying anyone further than this.
toa-adventure-tracker.notify.noGM: No GM connected — changes cannot be saved right now.
toa-adventure-tracker.notify.badRoleJson: Custom roles: invalid JSON ({error}). Falling back to the default list.
toa-adventure-tracker.notify.noGroup: The configured group actor was not found. Using all player characters instead.
toa-adventure-tracker.notify.badYield: The yield formula of role "{role}" could not be rolled.
toa-adventure-tracker.notify.emptyLog: The logbook is empty — nothing to export.
toa-adventure-tracker.notify.resolveFirs: Resolve the day before completing it.
toa-adventure-tracker.confirm.completeDa: Complete day {day}? The party covers {hexes} hexes and {n} travellers carry something away from it. Damage and exhaustion will be written to the character sheets.
toa-adventure-tracker.confirm.resolveAga: This day is already resolved. Resolving again rerolls the weather, encounters and saving throws. Nothing has been written to any sheet yet.
toa-adventure-tracker.confirm.clearLog: Clear the entire logbook? This cannot be undone — export it first if you want to keep it.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.raptors: They come from three directions at once, silent until the last leap. Feathers, claws, and the shrieking only starts once one of you is already down.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.zombieHorde: The forest floor itself stands up. Half-rotted hands reach out between the roots, then there are dozens — the death curse gives nobody back here.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.snake: Nobody sees it. The branch over the path is not a branch, and it strikes once the party is already half past. The venom works faster than the shock.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.pterafolk: The shadow over the clearing is too large for a bird. They stoop, snatch someone out of the line and carry them a way before letting go.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.batiri: Pit traps, trip lines, poisoned darts from the undergrowth — the goblins do not fight, they wear you down. When they melt away, gear is missing and someone is bleeding.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.assassinVine: What looked like a root wraps around an ankle and pulls tight. The vine is in no hurry; it has time, and the rest of the party has to find it first.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.stirges: First a humming, then a dozen proboscis-tipped bodies in your face. Ridiculous alone, a blood donation nobody offered as a swarm.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.girallon: Four arms, no hesitation. The white ape crashes through the undergrowth, grabs whoever is nearest and slams them into a trunk before anyone draws.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.yuanti: They have been watching since you crossed the stream. The first arrows come out of nowhere, then voices that hiss rather than speak.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.quicksand: The ground gives way without warning. Whoever sinks sinks fast, and the hour it takes to haul them out is not the day's only wound.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.tRexTracks: Prints with rainwater still standing in them — fresh enough that it has not drained. The vanguard raises a hand. You take the long way around the territory.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.raptorsSeen: Feather tips above the ferns, two heartbeats too early for them. You back out of the picture quietly, and they hunt something else.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.zombiesSeen: They shuffle in a line, purposeful as pilgrims, straight across your path. The vanguard waves everyone down. You wait for the last one to pass — it takes a while.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.grungPatrol: Poison-coloured frogs with spears, high in the branches. They do not see you because you saw them first. A detour is cheaper than a negotiation.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.hadrosaurs: A wall of bodies, unhurried and utterly indifferent. Getting between them would be fatal; walking behind them is comfortable — the path is trampled flat.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.tabaxiHunter: She has been standing there a while before you notice her. She wants nothing except to know where you are going. Her tip about the ford further north sounds honest.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.vegepygmies: Fungal growths in human shape, still between the trunks. They do not attack as long as nobody enters their grove — which lies exactly where you were headed.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.aldani: Lobster bodies in the murky water, eyes above the surface. The vanguard reads the pattern in time. You keep your distance, they keep theirs.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.flailSnail: A shell the size of a cart, shimmering in every colour. Slow enough to avoid — and valuable enough that someone briefly considers not avoiding it.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.followedEyes: Nobody sees anything. Everybody feels it. Whatever is following your trail is in no hurry, and that is the unsettling part.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.batiriTrail: An arrow out of the thicket, then laughter and running feet. They are only testing how awake you are. The answer costs blood.
toa-adventure-tracker.eventName.undeadFo: A trail that does not end
toa-adventure-tracker.event.undeadFollow: In the morning there are strange footprints around the camp. Bare, dragging, and they lead only in, never out.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.kamadan: The leopard with snakes along its back does not hunt from hunger but from habit. It takes the last in line and is gone before anyone can aim.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.drumsAtNight: They start as the fire burns low and stop whenever someone stands up. Nobody sleeps well. Nobody says what they were thinking.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.circles: That fallen trunk with the ring of mushrooms looks familiar. By the third time nobody is arguing about it — you have been here before.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.riverWrong: You follow the watercourse, because watercourses lead somewhere. This one leads, after hours, into a delta that is on no map.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.canopyDark: The canopy closes so tightly that noon and evening look the same. Without the sun, navigation becomes guessing, and the guess was wrong.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.ravine: The path ends at a split in the ground, too wide to jump. The detour along the edge eats the day and the strength.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.swampDetour: Firm ground turns soft, soft ground turns to water. Every step costs double, and by evening you stand almost where you started.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.backtrack: The cartographer compares three bearings and shakes their head. You walk two hours back, find the mistake — and lose only the rest of the day.
toa-adventure-tracker.eventName.mapRedra: The map was wrong, not you
toa-adventure-tracker.event.mapRedrawn: The river on the parchment does not match the one in front of you. The cartographer redraws it and finds the bearing again.
toa-adventure-tracker.eventName.landmark: A rock that is on the map
toa-adventure-tracker.event.landmark: A ridge pushes up between the treetops, unmistakable. One fix is enough to turn being lost into merely being late.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.stagnant: It is wet, it is drinkable, and it smells of nothing good. You drink it anyway, because the alternative is nothing at all.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.leeches: Only while filling the skins does anyone notice what has fastened onto arms and legs. Burning them off takes time and leaves marks.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.carcass: The water tastes sweetish. An hour later the vanguard finds the carcass that has been lying in the stream for days — upstream of where you drew.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.brackish: What you bottle is closer to broth than water. It stops the thirst, and the stomachs complain about it all evening.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.throatsDry: The last mouthful was mid-morning. By the afternoon nobody speaks, because speaking costs moisture.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.rationedSips: A capful per person per hour. Enough to keep walking, and not enough to feel good about it.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.heatHaze: The air stands still. Sweat dries before it runs, and that is not a good sign — the body has nothing left to give.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.bellyEmpty: The rations ran out days ago and the jungle offers nothing edible. The legs know it before the head does.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.rotten: The damp has won. What is left in the pack is furred and green and had better stay there.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.wetCamp: Not a dry patch anywhere. You lie in your own water, and in the morning nobody is rested.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.antSwarm: The column runs straight through the sleeping places. There are millions, they bite, and they do not negotiate.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.noFire: Every piece of wood is soaked. No fire means no hot meal, no smoke against the mosquitoes and no line between you and whatever is watching.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.mosquitoes: They arrive with dusk and do not stop. Whoever falls asleep wakes up. Whoever stays awake is just as wrecked by morning.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.monsoon: It does not rain, it comes down in walls. Visibility under ten paces, ground turned to porridge. Going on would be nonsense, so you do not.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.mudslide: The soaked slope gives way and takes half the path with it. Anyone not quick enough to the side goes along for part of the ride.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.lightning: The tree not twenty paces away all but explodes. Splinters, heat, and for a minute nobody hears anything.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.riverFlood: What was a ford in the morning is a torrent by afternoon. You are on the wrong side of it, and you wait.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.chwinga: A tiny nature spirit, curious and wordless, trots along for a while. Where it has been, everything hurts a little less.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.ruinShelter: Weathered steps lead under an intact stone roof. For the first time in days the party sleeps dry.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.freshSpring: Water comes out of the rock, cold and without an aftertaste. Every skin full, and nobody has to close their eyes to drink.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.gameTrail: A beaten path, wide enough for two, running exactly your way. For once the jungle makes room.
toa-adventure-tracker.event.fruitGrove: Ripe fruit, more than you can carry, and none of it poisonous. The forager grins all afternoon.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.cycleLeng: How many days a full lunar cycle takes. Default: 30.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.fullMoonD: Day of the first full moon
The travel day that is a full moon. Every other phase follows from it. Default: 1.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.slowNavMo: Modifier on the navigation roll at a slow pace. Default: +5.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.normalNav: Modifier on the navigation roll at a normal pace. Default: 0.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.fastNavMo: Modifier on the navigation roll at a fast pace. Default: −3. Only a fast pace can reach 2 hexes at all — at the cost of more days lost entirely.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.usePaceRu: Also hands the travel pace to dnd5e so its own rules apply (advantage on Stealth while slow, and so on). Independent of the modifier above.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.stormChan: How often a travel day drowns in a storm. A storm brings a lot of water and costs the day. Default: 10.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.rainChanc: How often it rains, on top of the storms. The remaining days stay dry. Default: 55 — Chult in the wet season.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.rainCatch: Collects extra water on rainy days. Useless on a dry one.
Extra gallons on a rainy day. Default: 4.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.encounter: Base chance that the day turns up something with teeth. Pace and the rearguard move it. Default: 20.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.partySour: Where the list of travellers comes from.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.groupActo: Name, id or uuid of the group actor. Used only when "A group actor" is selected above.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.travelers: 0 means: as many as the traveller source contains. Higher values for bearers and pack animals.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.customRol: A JSON array that extends or overrides the default roles by id. Format documented in the README.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.waterPerH: In gallons. A clear, blazing day raises the need automatically. Default: 2.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.hungerGra: How many days the party may go hungry before it costs exhaustion. Thirst has no grace. Default: 2.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.applyCons: Completing a day actually enters damage and exhaustion. Switched off, the report still shows what would have happened.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.rollSaves: Rolls the saves events call for through the system. Switched off, every save counts as failed — harsher, but right for tables that roll their own.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.skipRollD: Rolls immediately, without dnd5e's configuration dialog. Applies to you only.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.partySour: All characters with a player owner
